[Pre-reflection] The strategy's reliance on rigid crossover rules may generate false signals during trending markets or high-volatility periods. Overfitting is likely due to the specific indicator thresholds (e.g., RSI < 30, bollinger.lower crossover), which may not generalize well. The exit logic using RSI > 50 for longs is problematic as it can lead to late exits during strong trends.
[Backup plan] If results are poor, test a volatility-adjusted entry filter using ATR to avoid entries during low-volatility ranges. If Sharpe is low, optimize Bollinger Bands' length and multiplier, or switch to a dynamic RSI threshold. As an alternative, consider a momentum-based filter (e.g., MACD) combined with Bollinger Bands to improve signal quality and reduce whipsaws.
